summary: Verified route-based travel pricing feature end-to-end (backend + admin UI). Existing pytest /app/backend/tests/test_travel_pricing.py: 7/7 pass. New /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_travel_review.py: 7/7 pass covering admin settings auth/persistence, preview manual_review, customer travel-estimate no-leak (fuel/maintenance/processing/gallons/breakdown absent from body), 400 on short address, booking flags requires_manual_review + pending_customer_approval, GET /api/quotes shows requires_approval + approval_status=pending_approval, admin /api/admin/all-bookings shows the manual-review booking, /api/admin/pricing/preview also requires auth. Admin UI: pricing tile opens data-testid=pricing-settings-modal with all ps-* fields, gas_price_per_gallon change to 5.10 persists across close+reopen (verified 5.1), restored to 4.79, preview with '1500 N Fort Valley Rd, Flagstaff, AZ' renders data-testid=travel-manual-review red box quoting Google billing error. All Jobs modal shows the seeded manual-review card with red travel-manual-review box, PENDING CUSTOMER APPROVAL badge, and $150 AI base intact. Seed data cleaned from Mongo.

issues: Console spam: 'LoadScript has been reloaded unintentionally - You should not pass libraries prop as new array' repeated ~15x on every admin nav. Also 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' a11y warning on the pricing modal. Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: (Optional) Hoist the Google Maps `libraries` array to a module-level const to silence the LoadScript reload warning.
(Optional) Add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby to <DialogContent data-testid=pricing-settings-modal> for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: travel_pricing.google_route_miles raises RoutingError with the raw Google error_message ('You must enable Billing on the Google Cloud Project ...'). The customer-facing /quotes/{id}/travel-estimate maps it to a friendly message (verified no-leak), but admin preview surfaces the raw text through data-testid=travel-manual-review. That's fine for admin, just confirming the split is intentional.

coerce_settings clamps rounding_increment to a min of 0.01 but round_up treats increment<=0 as 'no rounding'. Because clamp forbids 0, the 'no rounding' branch is unreachable via settings; harmless but dead-code-ish.
PricingSettingsModal.jsx passes `libraries` as an inline prop to LoadScript causing repeated re-inits (see console). Move to a stable ref.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin pricing modal + preview + all-jobs manual-review card)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 quote + 1 booking (email travel@test.com, description TEST_ITER23_*) during UI verification, plus ephemeral pairs inside pytest — all deleted at end (delete_one + delete_many by TEST_ITER23 description / travel@test.com email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Directions returns REQUEST_DENIED (no billing) in this env — manual_review is the expected result everywhere; ignore raw 'You must enable Billing' text on admin-only surfaces (data-testid=travel-manual-review). Customer travel-estimate response has been verified to never contain 'fuel/maintenance/processing/gallons/breakdown'. Admin pricing settings testids: bin-tile-pricing (open), pricing-settings-modal, ps-{base-address,disposal-address,tow_mpg,gas_price_per_gallon,maintenance_pct,processing_pct,processing_fixed_fee,default_disposal_fee,rounding_increment,enabled,recover-fees,preview-address,preview-base,preview-btn,save-btn}. Booking flow: POST /api/quotes -> POST /api/quotes/{id}/travel-estimate -> POST /api/bookings; manual_review path sets booking.status=pending_customer_approval + booking.requires_manual_review + quote.approval_status=pending_approval.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works as designed. Google billing is intentionally disabled in this env, so all live routing goes through the manual_review branch which is exercised and verified.
